title: Question on the page "connectCurrentRefinedValues"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[connectCurrentRefinedValues](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectCurrentRefinedValues.html)".

Hi, I can't find a way to build a widget, which allows the user to clear all currently selected filters of one attribute. So instead of having eg:
- Brand: Brand name 1
- Brand: Brand name 2
- Capacity: 50ml
- Capacity: 100ml
- Capacity: 150ml

I'd like to render it like this:
- Brand: Brand 1, Brand 2    xClearUrl
- Capacity: 50ml, 100ml, 150ml    xClearUrl

Any help on that topic?
